_说明: viewer3d.html?model=mage_tower 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。中层机构区一座八边形逐层收分的粗琢石塔（约 92 m）+ 六角结界罩塔冠 + 环形裙房 + 庭院围墙与南门；只画建筑，无人物、文字、徽记。周边楼群、甲板与磁浮轨道（bg_*）只在成图里。卡只写了「法师塔」这个名字与首席神宫寺凛，详见 docs/landmarks/mage_tower.md。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 八边形逐层收分的粗琢石塔，三圈挑出的石栏平台，竖向嵌八条发光符文石脊。
desc.en: An octagonal, tapering rough-stone tower with three jutting balcony rings and eight glowing rune ribs set into its face.

desc.zh: 六角结界罩，罩内一颗悬浮的脉动核心晶体，外绕两圈符文环。
desc.en: A hexagonal ward shell housing a floating, pulsing core crystal, ringed by two runic bands.

desc.zh: 环绕塔基的两层裙房：石砌基座 + 玻璃幕鼓环 + 石柱，柱间挂纯色全息面板。
desc.en: A two-storey ring around the base: a stone plinth, a glazed drum, stone piers, and plain holo panels between them.

desc.zh: 围合庭院的石墙，南侧唯一门楼。
desc.en: A stone wall enclosing the courtyard, with the only gatehouse on its south side.

desc.zh: 门楼下的校验门，安检门造型，魔法蓝紫配色，无文字。
desc.en: A gate-shaped mana scanner under the gatehouse, in a blue-violet magitech finish, unlabelled.

desc.zh: 石径、松柏，几处悬浮装饰浮石。
desc.en: Stone paths, pines, and a few floating decorative rocks.

desc.zh: 庭院铺装，中央嵌一块六角发光法阵（纯几何，无文字）。
desc.en: Paved ground with a glowing hexagonal circle set at the centre (pure geometry, no text).
